title: leucanthemum ircutianum var. sylvestre
intro: Leucanthemum ircutianum var. sylvestre, commonly known as Siberian daisy, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include immune system stimulation, wound healing, and antiparasitic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents of Siberian daisy include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
